beaches.name: Plage d'Euronat
beaches.summary: The Euronat beach and the beach south of it are reserved for naturists. The commune's arrêté n°2025-41D (art. 6) reserves both 'plus particulièrement' to naturists of the Euronat site; a lifeguarded zone runs 250 m either side of the post from 15 June to 14 September 2025. Art. 8 forbids naturism at Le Gurp beach, with limits marked by signs.

beaches.name: Plage naturiste du CHM Montalivet
beaches.summary: The commune designates the whole CHM beach as a naturist beach. Bathing arrêté D-2026-235 of 30 June 2026 heads Article 5 'Plage naturiste du Centre Hélio Marin (C.H.M)' and sets lifeguard cover there daily 6 June–13 September 2026 plus May weekends, but does not itself state nudity rules; the FFN Aquitaine council dates the authorising arrêté to 21 July 1967. Article 12 bans, throughout the regulated zone, dress 'portant atteinte à la pudeur et aux bonnes mœurs'.

beaches.name: Plage d'Arnaoutchot
beaches.summary: Naturism is authorised across Arnaoutchot beach by municipal arrêté of 4 July 1974. The FFN Aquitaine council lists it among the region's ten officially authorised naturist beaches; Landes Attractivité lists it as a supervised naturist beach with lifeguards in July, August and early September.
